thread.title: Stocks Today: Apple, Netflix, Nvidia Lead Nasdaq 100 Lower | Investor's Business Daily

author: KEN SHREVE
title: Stocks Today: Apple, Netflix, Nvidia Lead Nasdaq 100 Lower | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The stock market pared losses significantly in afternoon trading Wednesday. Stocks today under pressure included Apple ( AAPL ), Netflix ( NFLX ) and Nvidia ( NVDA ) in the Nasdaq 100.
X After an intraday gain of nearly 1.2%, the Nasdaq reversed sharply lower but was back to nearly breakeven in late trading. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones industrial average were down by 0.1% to 0.2%. Volume on the NYSE and Nasdaq was tracking about 5% to 10% higher than Tuesday's levels. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Money flowed into bonds Wednesday, knocking the 10-year Treasury yield lower by 3 basis points to 3.11%. The regional bank group took a hit as a result, down 2.5%.
U.S. crude oil futures for December delivery snapped a lengthy losing streak, settling at $56.25 a barrel, up 1%.
Uptrend Under Pressure Indexes have seen nothing but selling since the Nasdaq composite and S&P 500 confirmed a new uptrend with big percentage gains in higher volume Nov. 7. It's clearly a risky environment to be putting money to work in stocks, even though the market is technically still in a confirmed uptrend. Always listen to the story the market is telling. What it's saying lately is that sellers are back in control, although Wednesday's move off lows was impressive.
The bulls liked the look of an elevated put-call volume ratio. It was at an elevated level of 1.22 in late trading, indicating excessive fear. Excessive fear has been seen at market bottoms in the past.
Stocks Today Among the day's gainers in the stock market today, Sprouts Farmers Market ( SFM ) outperformed, rising 2%. One of many top stocks today in the retail sector, Sprouts is a bit of an anomaly in the market as it works on the right side of a well-contoured base. It's approaching a buy point of 29.77.
MarketSmith Growth 250 stock Duluth Holdings ( DLTH ) also showed strength, rising 1.5%. Its relative strength line is near highs as the stock consolidates gains.
Elsewhere, two stocks that gapped up recently on earnings continue to hold gains bullishly. Ubiquiti Networks ( UBNT ) was up 1.8%, while Crocs ( CROX ) jumped 2%.
Meanwhile, enthusiasm over strong earnings and bullish guidance from Macy's ( M ) was short-lived. The stock erased an intraday gain of 4.3%, falling 7.5%. Results from group peer Nordstrom ( JWN ) are due Thursday after the close.
Marijuana stocks continued their downward spiral as investors weighed earnings from Canopy Growth ( CGC ). Shares crumbled nearly 6% after the company reported a wider-than-expected loss. Competitor Tilray ( TLRY ) slumped 8% after reporting earnings late Tuesday.
